Game Overview

Lily Escape puts players into a platformer experience centered on help Lily dash through a rainy beach, jumping over obstacles and clever enemies. Tap to leap and push rocks to strike foes. Collect fruits to boost your score while dodging nasty nail-throwers. With its intuitive controls, this exciting adventure is perfect for players of all ages.

How to Play

Playing Lily Escape comes down to a simple loop. Help Lily dash through a rainy beach, jumping over obstacles and clever enemies. Tap to leap and push rocks to strike foes. Collect fruits to boost your score while dodging nasty nail-throwers. With its intuitive controls, this exciting adventure is perfect for players of all ages.
